claim_boundary: This is a two-seed mechanism diagnostic on frozen pilot checkpoints, not a formal confirmation gate and not evidence for a new architecture.

estimand.edge_order: all unordered item pairs in lexicographic integer order
estimand.exact_posterior_preference: 2 * P(i ranks higher than j | realized support evidence) - 1
estimand.group_estimand: decompose the cohort-mean field; bootstrap subjects before taking each cohort mean
estimand.hodge_decomposition: orthogonal complete-graph projection F_ij = (s_i - s_j) + c_ij
estimand.human_choice_preference: 2 * observed pair choice probability - 1, reconstructed from ten trials per pair
estimand.human_sampling_boundary: primary cross-source inference uses the 77-subject cohort mean so finite ten-trial pair noise is averaged rather than mistaken for individual conjunctive code
estimand.sign: positive means the first item is preferred as higher

overall_diagnosis.next_mechanism_test: test local/conjunctive traces alongside the preserved global assembly baseline

projection_boundary: Hodge gradient fields are not clipped to [-1, 1]. Their linear accuracy components may fall outside [0, 1]; only the recombined total is a choice probability, while component slopes are additive decomposition estimands.
